操作失敗，請稍後重試。: Operation failed, please try again later.
請選擇 ASLUNG ID 和完整查詢期間。: Please select ASLUNG ID and full query period.
結束時間必須晚於開始時間。: End time must be after start time.
依授權設備與 UTC 期間查詢一頁量測資料，並更新頁面結果。: Query a page of measurement data based on authorized device and UTC period, and update page results.
設備與資料期間由管理員指定。: Devices and data periods are designated by admins.
選擇設備與期間，查詢並下載您有權限的量測資料。: Select device and period to query and download your authorized measurement data.
建立設備識別資料，作為資料查詢與授權的依據。: Create device identification data as the basis for data query and authorization.
管理可登入工作空間的會員帳號。: Manage member accounts that can log in to the workspace.
指定每位會員可存取的設備與資料期間。: Specify devices and data periods accessible to each member.
追蹤設備分配至各實驗室或國外的擺放位置歷史紀錄。: Track the location history of devices distributed to laboratories or abroad.
透過 JSON 交換資料，連接 AWS EC2 量測資料來源。: Exchange data via JSON to connect to AWS EC2 measurement data sources.
登入您的 ASLUNG 工作空間: Log in to your ASLUNG Workspace
使用 Email 與密碼登入，查看您的設備與資料授權。: Log in with Email and password to view your devices and data grants.
管理員可建立 ASLUNG ID、開通會員與指定資料期間。: Admins can create ASLUNG IDs, activate members, and specify data periods.
帳號由管理員建立；請使用您的 Email 與密碼登入。: Accounts are created by admins; please log in with your Email and password.
查詢後顯示所選期間的量測紀錄: Measurement records for the selected period will be displayed after query
選擇 ASLUNG ID 與期間，按下: Select ASLUNG ID and period, press
先在 ASLUNG ID 管理建立設備，再設定資料來源。: First create a device in ASLUNG ID Management, then set the data source.
請聯絡管理員指派 ASLUNG ID 與資料期間。: Please contact the administrator to assign an ASLUNG ID and data period.
此期間沒有量測資料: No measurement data in this period
請調整日期範圍後重新查詢。: Please adjust the date range and query again.
查詢完成後，將在此顯示實際 JSON 資料。: After query is complete, actual JSON data will be displayed here.
尚有更多資料；下載會自動合併所有分頁。: More data available; downloading will automatically merge all pages.
查詢結果直接來自既有資料來源；連線是否正常將於查詢時確認。: Query results come directly from the existing data source; connection will be verified during query.
會員、設備與授權可以先行設定。完成 API 串接後，即可查詢與下載實際資料。: Members, devices, and grants can be set in advance. After completing API connection, actual data can be queried and downloaded.
填寫設備 ID、名稱與地點，並為會員指定資料權限。: Fill in device ID, name and location, and assign data permissions to members.
此帳號將無法再管理系統。: This account will no longer be able to manage the system.
此帳號將能管理系統設定與其他帳號。: This account will be able to manage system settings and other accounts.
此會員將無法查詢或下載資料，既有授權仍保留。: This member will not be able to query or download data, existing grants are preserved.
此會員可重新使用已指派的設備授權。: This member can reuse assigned device grants.
管理員建立帳號後，請自行將 Email 與初始密碼交給會員；此操作不會寄送邀請信: After creating an account, please manually provide the Email and initial password to the member; this action does not send an invitation email. Members can change their password after logging in.
新增第一筆設備擺放位置。: Add the first device placement location.
先建立 ASLUNG ID 與會員，再指定可查詢的資料期間。: Create ASLUNG ID and members first, then specify the queryable data period.
確認後該會員將失去此紀錄區間的存取權限。: After confirmation, the member will lose access to this record period.
本系統已設定為直接連線至 EC2 的 rcec_lung 資料庫。: This system has been set to connect directly to the rcec_lung database on EC2.
系統直接對 rawdata 表格進行高效能分頁查詢。: The system performs high-performance paginated queries directly on the rawdata table.
權限控制：強制套用本系統的會員授權區間: Permission control: Enforce the member authorization interval of this system
前端介面與資料下載所使用的內部 API。: Internal API used for frontend interface and data download.
下方可產生您專屬的 Token 來供外部程式使用。: You can generate your exclusive Token below for use by external programs.
將產生一組隨機的新權杖供您的應用程式使用。: A random new token will be generated for your application to use.
所有正在使用此權杖的程式將立即無法連線。確認？: All programs using this token will be disconnected immediately. Confirm?
應與 EC2 資料來源的設備識別碼一致。: Should match the device identifier of the EC2 data source.
設定會員 Email 與初始密碼；會員登入後可變更密碼。: Set member Email and initial password; members can change their password after logging in.
記錄設備（包含國外站點）目前的擺放位置與期間。: Record the current placement location and period of the device (including overseas sites).
變更後將登出所有裝置，請使用新密碼重新登入。: You will be logged out of all devices after changing; please log in again with the new password.
指定會員可存取的設備與資料期間；相同會員與設備會更新原有授權。: Specify devices and data periods accessible to members; existing grants for the same member and device will be updated.
